title: KSLA-002 Imaginary Kitten Random Action Solver

source_relatives.work: Nesterov, Efficiency of Coordinate Descent Methods on Huge-Scale Optimization Problems
source_relatives.role: random partial-coordinate updates for huge-scale optimization

source_relatives.work: Strohmer and Vershynin, A Randomized Kaczmarz Algorithm with Exponential Convergence
source_relatives.role: small random subproblem updates for linear systems

source_relatives.work: Stich, Mueller, Gaertner, Optimization of Convex Functions with Random Pursuit

novelty_boundary: KSLA-002 does not claim a new optimization primitive. It tests a systems abstraction in which logical kittens are stateless random action proposals with no model, process, gradient, objective, or matrix knowledge; an external validator supplies all correctness pressure.

fixture.matrix: tridiagonal SPD with diagonal 6 and off-diagonal -1
fixture.target_coordinates: deterministic integers in [-7,7] from frozen SHA256 domain
fixture.action_selection: uniform deterministic SHA256 fixture over coordinate and step
fixture.validator: accept only negative residual-norm delta; among a batch accept the best improving proposal
